displayPattern: Amber status LED on a Bryant 288BNV Evolution heat pump or 189BNV air conditioner. A short flash is 0.25 seconds on and a long flash is 1.0 second on. Code 31 is 3 short and 1 long
meaning: High pressure switch open. The unit steps down capacity for each occurrence and elevates to fault 84 if it happens on the lowest stage. Reset time is 6 minutes, then the unit runs at a reduced stage.
causes: The service manual points code 31 at the fault 84 cause list
Outdoor airflow too low or off, including a coil blocked by ice or debris
Overcharge, a closed service valve, or a restriction in the filter drier, EXV, TXV, or tubing
Loose high-pressure-switch harness, or the switch disconnected from the inverter
Faulty pressure switch, or the reversing valve stuck in cooling during a heating call
diySteps: With the disconnect and the breaker off, check the outdoor coil for ice or debris and clear it if you can do that without opening the electrical panel
Technician: follow the fault 84 table for charge, service valves, the filter drier, the expansion device, and the pressure-switch harness
safetyNote: Outdoor units carry line voltage even when the thermostat is off. Switch off the unit's disconnect and breaker before touching anything. Refrigerant, wiring, compressor and control-board work must be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if 31 repeats or becomes 84. The 6-minute reset is not a repair.
sourceTitle: Bryant 288BNV heat pump / 189BNV air conditioner service manual (SM288BNV-189BNV-04)
